Both players make MAGPIE's top static equity move until the bag is empty. The endgame is then played three ways from the same position: static vs static, the antistatic solver as P1, and the antistatic solver as P2. The antistatic player solves the endgame assuming its opponent plays static moves, which it does. Everything before the endgame is identical, so any difference comes from the endgame.
